packageRules.description: Mark patch, pin, and digest Docker updates for merge automation
Mark minor Docker updates for merge automation, except Python minor releases (e.g. 3.14 -> 3.15), which a maintainer merges

Ship Docker CLI/Compose security fixes sooner: the bundled Go binaries are scanned on every edge and release publish. Open the PR any day and without waiting for branch checks, which never run on a bare Renovate branch
